stem: If $X=\{2, -1\}$ and $Y=\{4, 0\}$, build $X\times Y$ by selecting all its ordered pairs.
solution: In $X\times Y$ the first component comes from $X$ and the second from $Y$.
notes: missing-pairs could reflect adding set sizes (adds-set-sizes) but more likely just an incomplete listing; not mapped to avoid a weak diagnosis.
